Specification: This specification models a single-variable counter over the natural numbers module, with one state variable x initialized to 3. The transition relation decrements x by 1 on every step, and the comment explicitly notes that the counter is allowed to go below zero, so negative values are expected behavior despite the module extending Naturals. The file also defines a state invariant Inv asserting x >= 0, but it does not define a full temporal specification such as Spec or any fairness or liveness properties.
